launch.headline: A better brief for a changing conversation.
launch.subhead: A restaurant enquiry can change in a single message.
launch.narration: A booking enquiry doesn't stay still. FormBridge keeps the brief accurate as the conversation changes.

launch.headline: One message. Five linked details.
launch.narration: A customer asks for a table at Juniper and Stone in Sydney. One message fills the brief and links every detail to its source.

launch.headline: The plan changes. The brief follows.
launch.subhead: Five guests. After eight. Exact time still open.
launch.narration: Then the plan changes: five guests, and sometime after eight. FormBridge retires the old time and asks for an exact one.

launch.headline: An offer is not an answer.
launch.subhead: Staff proposes 8:30 pm. The brief waits.
launch.narration: Staff offers eight thirty. The offer stays a proposal until the customer agrees.

launch.headline: Agreement closes the loop.
launch.subhead: The time resolves with both messages linked.
launch.narration: Once the customer accepts, the time resolves to eight thirty, with both messages linked as evidence.

launch.headline: Ready for handoff. No table booked.
launch.subhead: Explore the live demo at formbridge-nlp-at2.vercel.app
launch.narration: A person reviews and approves the brief. No table is booked. FormBridge prepares a clear handoff.

walkthrough.headline: From conversation to reviewed brief.
walkthrough.subhead: A real run through the live web app with synthetic messages.
walkthrough.narration: Here is FormBridge, a staff-facing workspace for turning a changing restaurant enquiry into a reviewable booking brief. This walkthrough uses synthetic messages in the live app.

walkthrough.headline: Start with the customer's words.
walkthrough.subhead: No values are invented before a message arrives.
walkthrough.narration: A new brief begins empty. The conversation is on the left, and the booking card is on the right. Each field starts as missing until the customer supplies information.

walkthrough.headline: Read the request in context.
walkthrough.subhead: Five values, each linked to message one.
walkthrough.narration: The customer asks for Juniper and Stone in Sydney, on the ninth of October, at seven, for four guests. FormBridge extracts the five booking details. Each value links back to the message that supplied it.

walkthrough.headline: Corrections replace old values.
walkthrough.subhead: Four becomes five. Seven o'clock is retired.
walkthrough.narration: The customer changes their mind. Four guests becomes five. Seven o'clock no longer applies. Since after eight is only a preference, the exact time becomes unresolved and the interface asks a targeted question.

walkthrough.headline: See why a field changed.
walkthrough.subhead: Select a field to see its source message.
walkthrough.narration: Click the time field and FormBridge highlights the customer message behind the change. The audit trail also shows the previous time and party size, so staff can review what was superseded.

walkthrough.headline: Staff can suggest. The customer decides.
walkthrough.subhead: An 8:30 pm offer does not finalize the brief.
walkthrough.narration: Now staff offers eight thirty. The app keeps the time open, because a staff suggestion is not the customer's acceptance. This prevents an unconfirmed proposal from becoming a booking detail.

walkthrough.headline: The customer says yes.
walkthrough.subhead: 8:30 pm is linked to offer and acceptance.
walkthrough.narration: When the customer accepts, the time resolves to eight thirty. The field links to both the staff offer and the customer's reply, so the meaning is clear even though the reply is short.

walkthrough.headline: A person approves the brief.
walkthrough.narration: The staff member reviews the five details, approves the booking brief, and can download it as JSON. Approval is a handoff step. It does not reserve a table or check restaurant availability.

walkthrough.headline: Clear state. Visible evidence. Human control.
walkthrough.narration: FormBridge makes uncertainty visible and keeps people in control. Try the public demo with synthetic messages at formbridge-nlp-at2 dot vercel dot app.
